t: A logic gate simulator for building and testing digital circuits.
steps: Open the online version of Logicly in a browser.
Download the desktop trial for Windows or macOS if needed.
Build an AND gate with two switches and a light.
Use step-by-step debugging to watch the signal.
Review the Classroom and Campus license prices.
Ask IT to install a paid license on lab computers.
Prepare a custom circuit library for students.
